no-built-in-evaluation-or-data-plan.check: Look for a clause requiring review against the stated purpose and data to do it. Ask who performs the review.
no-built-in-evaluation-or-data-plan.fix: Add an independent evaluation duty with a data plan and a published report.

powers-never-commenced-or-used.check: Find powers that need a start date or a first act. Ask whether any duty requires them to be brought into operation or reported on if not used.
powers-never-commenced-or-used.fix: Add a commencement date and a duty to report why any power has not been used.

reform-that-codifies-existing-practice.check: Compare the new rule with current practice. Ask how many past cases it would have changed.
reform-that-codifies-existing-practice.fix: Add a measurable change or a review of whether the rule alters practice.

committee-review-bypassed.check: Check how the text moved through the process. Ask whether it passed under emergency or leadership procedure, and whether a cleanup stage was skipped.
committee-review-bypassed.fix: Require committee review and a posting period before floor action, and a technical review of the final text.

externally-drafted-or-model-text.check: Compare the text with outside documents. Ask whether it was drafted by or copied from an outside organization, and whether that is disclosed.
externally-drafted-or-model-text.fix: Require disclosure of outside drafters and a review of the text against the bill's purpose.

automatic-effect-absent-disapproval.check: Find recommendations that take effect unless the legislature acts. Ask who can stop them, how quickly, and what happens if no one does.
automatic-effect-absent-disapproval.fix: Require an affirmative approval step, or a clear window and procedure for disapproval.

expedited-procedure-that-limits-amendmen.check: Find fast track procedures. Ask what debate and amendment they allow, and what changes could not be made.
expedited-procedure-that-limits-amendmen.fix: Allow amendment and a minimum debate period, or limit fast track to defined cases.

authority-to-skip-public-comment.check: Find routes that allow rules to take effect without comment, such as good cause or interim final rules. Ask what limits them.
authority-to-skip-public-comment.fix: Limit skipping comment to stated circumstances, set a sunset on interim rules and require later notice and comment.

no-comparative-print.check: Look for a document showing how the bill changes existing law. Ask whether readers can see the changes without assembling them.
no-comparative-print.fix: Require a comparative print to be published before consideration.

no-cost-or-regulatory-impact-statement.check: Look for a cost estimate and a regulatory impact evaluation with the bill. Ask who prepared them and whether they cover the main provisions.
no-cost-or-regulatory-impact-statement.fix: Require a cost estimate and impact evaluation before consideration.

no-agency-technical-review.check: Look for technical assistance from the agency that will administer the bill. Ask whether the text was reviewed for workability.
no-agency-technical-review.fix: Request and publish a technical review from the administering agency before enactment.

provision-added-or-dropped-late.check: Compare earlier versions of the vehicle with the final text. Ask what was added or removed late, especially checks, fixes and shields.
provision-added-or-dropped-late.fix: Require a posting period for late changes and a record of what was added or dropped.

drafting-and-reading-conventions-differ.check: Compare the drafting style with the canons courts apply. Ask where the text could be read in ways its authors did not expect.
drafting-and-reading-conventions-differ.fix: Have the text reviewed against common interpretive canons and add construction rules where they differ.

procedure-that-favors-a-constituency.check: Read procedural rules for who receives information, standing or veto points. Ask whether a particular group gains an advantage.
procedure-that-favors-a-constituency.fix: Open procedural rights to affected parties generally and require public notice of key steps.
